figs.name: pressure-gauge-accuracy-classes-grade-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for choosing ASME B40.100 pressure gauge accuracy grade by application

figs.name: pressure-gauge-accuracy-classes-percent-of-span-infographic

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
